common_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
onboarding_desc_1: Set healthy daily screen-time boundaries and reduce distracting phone habits.
onboarding_desc_2: Focus Guard monitors usage, blocks apps when limits expire, and can lock the phone for the day.
onboarding_desc_3: A parent PIN or pattern protects limits, settings, and emergency unlocks.
permissions_intro: Enable every required Android permission so app usage can be measured and blocked reliably.
permission_usage_access_desc: Reads daily phone and application usage from Android UsageStatsManager.
permission_accessibility_desc: Detects the foreground app and blocks restricted apps immediately.
permission_overlay_desc: Displays the full-screen lock page above blocked apps.
permission_notification_desc: Keeps protection running and warns when permissions are disabled.
permission_battery_desc: Prevents Android from stopping protection in the background.
security_intro: Create a parent PIN or pattern. Only this secret can change limits, disable protection, or unlock blocked apps.
security_mismatch: The entries do not match or are too short.
parent_unlock_desc: Enter the parent PIN or pattern sequence to continue.
app_limit_none: No limit set for this app.
phone_limit_explain: When today's total usage reaches this value, Focus Guard shows a protected full-screen lock until a parent unlocks it or the day resets.
blocking_come_back: Come back tomorrow after your usage resets.
settings_about_desc: A production Flutter app using UsageStatsManager, AccessibilityService, a foreground service, overlays, and parent security to reduce phone addiction.
usage_weekly_chart_desc: Your total screen time for each day.
usage_weekly_chart_semantics: Seven-day usage chart. Highest daily usage: {}.
usage_chart_empty: No usage has been recorded yet.
settings_uninstall_standard_desc: Android does not let a normal app ask for its own PIN during the system uninstall flow. Activate Device Admin for additional protection. Full uninstall blocking requires this app to be provisioned as a Device Owner or Profile Owner.
settings_uninstall_managed_desc: This managed device can block removal of Focus Guard. A parent PIN is required here before changing the protection.
settings_uninstall_blocked: Focus Guard cannot be uninstalled while this protection is on.
settings_uninstall_not_blocked: Removal is currently allowed by Android policy.
settings_device_admin_active: Device Admin is active. A managed-device setup is still required for full uninstall blocking.
